en: John 10

p.src: 1  “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

en: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

p.src: 2  But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

en: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
u.src: 2  But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

p.src: 3  The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

p.src: 4  Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

en: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
u.src: 4  Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

p.src: 5  They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

en: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

p.src: 7  Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

p.src: 9  I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

p.src: 10  The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

p.src: 11  “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

en: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

p.src: 12  He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

en: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

en: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

p.src: 14  I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

en: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

p.src: 15  even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

en: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
